summary: An on/off switch with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: On state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: the switch must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Moves from the start to the end of the track when on; follows dir.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with the primary color; thumb moves to the end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute, or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl: setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the checked attribute default, disabled (own or from a fieldset) is not submitted, error sets a customError validity.

accessibility.targetSize: The track is 32x20px (24x16px at sm), under 24px high; the label beside it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). It does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; the on/off state is exposed as aria-checked natively
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
on/off is not conveyed by color alone: the thumb position changes too
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is either on or off and takes effect as it is set
The effect or format of the setting needs explaining
The setting must be on before submit
useCases.use: required with a label that states it

useCases.when: Space is tight, such as a dense settings row

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice recorded only when the form is submitted, such as agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: Switches read as immediate settings; a recorded yes/no choice is a checkbox

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch is one independent on/off

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that flips with the state, such as "Enable" turning into "Disable"
antiPatterns.why: The on/off state is already announced; a changing label reads as the opposite state
antiPatterns.alternative: A stable label that names the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default off-track is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset
shadcn default is 32x18.4px, sm 24x14px; the semantic size.switch tokens are used

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern on a native checkbox with role=switch; the visual reference for look and sizes.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> or a custom role=switch element?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox with role=switch (recommended): Space, focus, validity and form participation come with it, as in Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: What does Enter do?
openQuestions.answer: Submits the form (implicit submission, SB-0009), like Checkbox. The APG makes Enter on a switch optional and a native checkbox does not toggle on Enter.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No (recommended). The attribute is the default that form reset restores, as in Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and is there a hide-label prop?
openQuestions.answer: label is required. No hide-label for now: it was not requested; add it by a contract change if a use appears.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default and sm, matching the visual reference and the existing size aliases (default=medium, sm=small).

openQuestions.question: What does required mean on a switch?
openQuestions.answer: The switch must be on: the native checkbox rule (valueMissing while off).

openQuestions.question: Prop names: checked and error, or the canonical selected and errorMessage?
openQuestions.answer: checked and error (recommended): registered aliases in spec/api.json, native-like, and the same as Checkbox and Input.
